prompts.name: 01-drowned-archipelago
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready planetary ground albedo atlas for Void Drift. Reference image is a concept portrait, not an edit target. Create its matching FLAT FULL 360 DEGREE EQUIRECTANGULAR longitude-latitude SURFACE MAP, exact 2:1 landscape rectangle filled edge to edge with surface. Preserve its distinctive terrain, colours, water/ice and sci-fi idea, invent a coherent hidden hemisphere. Longitude left-right, north pole top, south pole bottom. Seamless periodic horizontal wrap with matching left/right edges; polar regions stretched horizontally for correct spherical mapping, no pinched vertical perspective. The atlas must be evenly lit diffuse albedo, consistent surface brightness across entire map. Remove ALL globe lighting, specular highlights, terminator, spherical silhouette, shadows, atmosphere, clouds, glow, background space, borders and text. Water is matte even blue/teal albedo, not white specular. Restrained painted mineral detail matching the portrait and existing Mercury/Cradle material. Keep broad coherent shapes and selective mid-scale texture; texture covers all pixels with no gaps. Not a rendered globe, not a perspective view, not a collage. Subject: A drowned archipelago world: deep muted slate-blue ocean covers 75% of the visible face; scattered broad weathered pale limestone islands and one fragmented olive-grey continent, beautifully readable shallow turquoise coastal shelves, small chalk-white polar ice. Science-fiction idea: three enormous ancient flooded circular basins partly interrupted by islands, subtle geological-scale suggestion of a lost engineered landscape. Keep circular structures sparse and integrated into the geography.
